question: Why does Firefox Troubleshoot.snapshot hang with blank Name/Version when the processes provider awaits ChromeUtils.requestProcInfo, while application-only stubs fill Name/Version?

allowedInputs.title: Reported: requestProcInfo rejects NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED when every QueryProcessCycleTime stub fails; Troubleshoot.processes never calls done()
allowedInputs.note: Reported: snapshot-probe requestProcInfo:ERR NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED; ChromeUtils rejects empty GetProcInfo map; processes provider hang leaves Name/Version blank
